title: Cavern Compass navigation
summary: Craft a Cavern Compass so you can find your linked gateway while exploring.

steps.title: Gather the materials
steps.body: Bring a Compass into the Dark Caverns, then mine Luminite Dust and Platinum Pieces.

steps.title: Craft the Cavern Compass
steps.body: Craft the Cavern Compass at a Crafting Table using the recipe shown below.

steps.title: Follow it back to your gateway
steps.body: The needle points to your linked gateway in the Dark Caverns. A normal Compass spins here, so keep the Cavern Compass with you on long trips.
steps.note: Use the Cavern Compass on a Lodestone to make the needle track that block instead.
